utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly heard second-hand, but I can spread the word and help track down volunteers or tools. If you’ve got the latest details, I’ll pass them along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Nell — I’m still catching up too, but I can help verify what’s been set up and pass along the details once we’ve got them straight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—just let me know what’s confirmed, and I’ll help spread it around the block.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start sharing it around and signing folks up for time slots.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — it’s at the community center on Maple this Saturday from 10 to 2. Please share that and send people my way for sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll share the community center on Maple, Saturday 10 to 2, and send folks your way for sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll help you make a clear missing-items list, and we can take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I only heard bits about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still helping sort the missing-items list, so once you tell me what’s already on hand, I can fill in the gaps. No rush — we’ll keep it simple and step by step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Vik — I’ve got the tools and gloves covered. If you need me, I may need a quick reminder about where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll remind you where to drop them off and keep passing the repair drive plan along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for your reminder and bring the tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira — I’m checking our supplies and will flag any gaps so we know what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really willing to help with the repair drive? If so, I can tell you what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m happy to help, and I’ll keep track of any supply gaps for the repair drive. Tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Keep me posted if you hear a date or any new details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll ask around today and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — I’ve got a few more tool contacts, plus tape, screws, and gloves to add.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that sounds useful — do we still have enough room at the hall for all of it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think so, but I’ll check the hall setup and make room if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it simple: community center on Maple, this Saturday from 10 to 2. If Hana wants, I can also mention we still need a few volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — that matches my notes. Please mention the volunteer and tool needs too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll mention we still need a few volunteers and some tools, along with the Maple community center details for Saturday from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily so far, nothing dramatic yet. I’m still hearing back from folks one by one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Rey — I’ll keep the list updated as replies come in, and we can slot people in as needed. If anything urgent pops up, send it my way and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re going to the community hall for sorting, and I heard there’s still a bit of room left there. If you want, I can also tell you which supplies they’re asking for most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Tess. Thank you for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ve heard they’re really short on cleaning supplies, tape, and basic tools right now. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any other updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t heard a date yet—have you learned anything on your side?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Mina. I’m still waiting on a date, and once I hear it I’ll make the list and plan the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli — please let me know as soon as you hear a date.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I can bring the tape and label the bins, and I’ll ask around about the before-school setup too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — I’ll check the garage supplies and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll handle the tape and labels.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and invite a few neighbors right away, and I can send you the details if you want to help with time slots too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll spread the word and invite a few neighbors right away, and send me the details if I help with time slots?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — that’s exactly right, and I’ll send the details over now so you can start with the time slots.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s still moving steadily, which is good. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear a date.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep passing the repair drive details along, and I’ll check back with you once the date is set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I’ll keep checking in and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Rey. If you give me the missing list, I’ll line it up and keep the plan simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send over the missing list and keep it simple on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much appreciated, Rey. Once I have that list, I’ll sort it into a simple step-by-step plan and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — drop-offs are around 8:15 and pickups around 3:00, so we can plan the repair drive around those windows.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the 8:15 drop-offs and 3:00 pickups noted. I’ll double-check the rest of the plan before we act.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can spread the word around the block, and if you’ve got the quick rundown on what still needed, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll send you the quick rundown, and I’ll check the main repairs first before skimming the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — that works for me. Just send the rundown when you have it, and I’ll help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know it’s at the community center on Maple this Saturday from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — that matches what I’ve got so far. I’ll help keep an eye on the details and can check in if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Dane — I’ll keep folks posted if anything shifts, and I’ll keep an eye out for more volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — Saturday morning works for me. Just point me to the donations and I’ll sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’m just checking we still have room at the hall and know where to send people. If you’re sorting, I can point you to the right table once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just let me know once you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll head to the right table.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — could you check whether the repair table by the garage still needs any supplies or signs?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check it now and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — please also note anything missing near the garage table, and let me know if the signs need replacing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. I really appreciate you helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — happy to help. Just let me know what you’d like me to handle next.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you help spread the word to a few neighbors on Maple and the corner houses? That would mean a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — they’re still mostly asking for tools, tarps, and cleaning supplies, and I haven’t heard any word that the hall’s getting too full yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll spread the word. Have they settled on a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not that I’ve heard yet — they’re still sorting the timing out. If I hear the date, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks for the reminder. I’ll bring a few tools and some gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll note those down and check what else we still need. That should help us keep the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’d appreciate that. If you see the labels, could you keep me pointed at the right boxes?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can help sort out the missing items and bring over any tools you still need for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s already on hand, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got the basics covered, but I still need a checklist of what’s missing so I can pass it along and fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll put together a clean missing-items checklist and keep it simple. Just tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll sort the rest.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
